objective: Public problem inputs -> image visually similar to original fp_sol reference; human judges appearance and boundary clarity

data.membership_caveat: v5 was historically selected using public MIB-area compatibility; original inputs/labels are now used without that transform, not a new unfiltered sample
data.test: sealed; E101 final-test authorization does not apply to E102
data.labels: original fp_sol only, WHXY -> XYWH -> RGB target; no teacher or prior model
data.network_input: public areas, module adjacency, MIB/group relations, boundary bits, fixed WH/preplaced XYWH, exact per-module external weight and weighted center, stable module identity/color

image.effective_area: fixed/preplaced public w*h; other blocks original target area
image.canvas: S=sqrt(sum effective_area); P=max preplaced x+w,y+h or 0; L=max(kappa*S,P+margin*S)
image.overflow: stop preparation; never silently crop or fit to reference; revise using train evidence only
image.precision: uint8 cached RGB, converted to FP32 [-1,1] during training

method: Fresh conditional image generator: relation-aware module Transformer -> 32x32 image queries attending to module tokens -> convolutional upsampling -> RGB; no geometry output
loss: Fixed unweighted mean squared RGB pixel error per image in [-1,1], then arithmetic mean across images; identical for backward, train/dev monitoring, best, LR and early stopping

training.engine: eager, no TF32, no mixed precision, no graph capture
training.launch_authorization: User explicitly requested background launch on 2026-11-06; one registered 512px seed0 run, preparation and reference/generated galleries only.

selection: Save every strictly improved dev_monitor500 RGB-MSE best; min_delta controls plateau reset only; latest saves optimizer/RNG/order/cursor/scheduler/elapsed budget separately
visual_evaluation: Same fixed dev100, early step100 preview and each dev500 RGB-MSE best, under visualization/E102_reference_image_generation/20261106_rgb512_seed0; pictures do not select checkpoints.
resolution_stage: Five fixed train_monitor500 members near n=21/45/70/95/120, compare 128/256/512/1024 whole images and same-physical-region enlargements; projected short-side pixels only describe raster fidelity
limitations: Five training images do not establish a population resolution threshold
An input need not uniquely identify its reference
MSE can encourage averaged blurry images
White background and large modules can dominate unweighted pixel loss
No formal model quality result exists until actual training and image review
later: Only after reviewing baseline images decide whether conditional diffusion/Flow Matching is warranted; no such candidate or follow-on run is automatically started
